restaurants.name: Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza
restaurants.description: Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza serves classic pizza, kebabs, wraps and burgers from its Oxford location. A no-fuss takeaway kitchen focusing on reliable, generous pizza and freshly grilled shish and doner kebabs - the kind of place you turn to for a satisfying, no-surprises meal delivered straight to your door.
restaurants.keywordSeoTitle: Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza - Kebab and Pizza in Oxford OX3 8RA | Just Eat
restaurants.keywordSeoDescription: Order online for delivery or collection from Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza in Marston, Oxford. Pizza, kebabs, wraps, burgers, sides and desserts. Free delivery on orders over £13. 3.8 (76).

faqs.question: What type of food does Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza serve?
faqs.answer: Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza serves Kebab, Pizza, Mediterranean and Grill food in Marston, Oxford. The menu covers pizzas in 10" and 14" sizes, doner and shish kebabs, wraps, burgers, sides, desserts and drinks.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery typically takes 35-50 minutes to Marston and the surrounding Oxford area. Collection is usually ready in around 20 minutes.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order for delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is a minimum order value of £13 for delivery. Collection orders have no minimum.

faqs.question: How much is delivery?
faqs.answer: Delivery is free on this restaurant. A service fee may apply at checkout depending on the order.

faqs.question: Does Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza offer a collection service?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can order for collection from the restaurant at 21 Atkyns Road, Oxford, OX3 8RA. Collection usually takes around 20 minutes.

faqs.question: What are the opening hours?
faqs.answer: Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza is open every day from 11:00 to 23:00.

faqs.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, cash on delivery is supported. Contactless payment is also available.

faqs.question: Is the food halal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Woodfarm Kebab & Pizza is a halal restaurant, specialising in doner and shish kebabs alongside pizza.

faqs.question: Does the menu have vegetarian options?
faqs.answer: Yes. There are vegetarian options including the Veggie pizza, Veggie Burger, Veggie Wrap, Halloumi dishes and a Falafel and Houmous Wrap.

faqs.question: How do I contact the restaurant?
faqs.answer: You can call the restaurant on 01865 642153 or visit the website at woodfarmkebabpizza.uk.
